id: SN1 normal: big number is the move since the first price after the article; before and after are in words; grey and coloured lines; marker with the publish time
SN2 the article was wrong: the card says so plainly
SN3 a move under 0.3% is reported as "barely moved", not as right or wrong
SN4 no recording yet (file missing): no chart, plain explanation, and today's real move from the price file
SN5 a single recorded price says tracking has started and promises the chart after the next update
SN6 the first price came more than 90 minutes after the article and nothing before it: not shown as a since-the-news chart
SN7 a late first price (30 min) is stated in the note and the change is measured from it; no before data is described honestly
SN8 the pure calculation ignores bad points, sorts, and never invents a before line from one point
SN9 layout: the card fits the panel with no sideways scroll; its text is at least 13 px (14 px on phones)
SN10 a story opened from a link before the prices have loaded still gets its card once they arrive
